name: knownva
description: KnowVa Academic Resource Platform — production monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @knownva/shared && npm run build -w @knownva/api && npm run build -w @knownva/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.kill: for p in 5000 5173 5174 5175; do fuser -k $p/tcp 2>/dev/null; done; pkill -f 'tsx watch' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f vite 2>/dev/null; echo '✓ all dev servers killed'
